title: fsl_glm
description: Simple GLM allowing temporal or spatial regression on either text data or images

output_file_out.description: Output file name for GLM parameter estimates (GLM betas)

output_copes_out.description: Output file name for COPEs (either as text file or image)

output_zstats_out.description: Output file name for Z-stats (either as text file or image)

output_tstats_out.description: Output file name for t-stats (either as text file or image)

output_pvals_out.description: Output file name for p-values of Z-stats (either as text file or image)

output_fvals_out.description: Output file name for F-value of full model fit

output_pfvals_out.description: Output file name for p-value for full model fit

output_varcb_out.description: Output file name for variance of COPEs

output_sigsq_out.description: Output file name for residual noise variance sigma-square

output_data_out.description: Output file name for pre-processed data

output_vnscales_out.description: Output file name for scaling factors for variance normalisation
